status: G5 pilot: processed, compressed and reviewed; in the game at Chapter III's station and Chapter VIII's ferry (desktop build, High)
use: The battle's abandoned supply cart (the field object 'stores'), on its cell of the board, in every state; its load stands on the bed while the cart is still to be recovered.

generator.prompt: An abandoned Roman army supply cart: a sturdy two-wheeled cart about two and a half metres long including its pole and one and a half metres wide, with a flat plank bed and low slatted side rails, two large spoked wooden wheels with iron tyres on a timber axle, and a single draught pole with a short yoke bar resting on the ground in front. The bed is empty apart from a folded leather cover. Weathered grey-brown wood and dark iron. Single isolated static prop for a grounded painterly-realistic historical game set in the third century Roman world. Physically based aged materials, believable hand-made construction and strong readable silhouette, restrained surface detail, level base and complete geometry from every side. review.scope: Tripo's own render, four views of the final compressed model with a 1.8 m figure for scale (scripts/assets/preview-model.mjs), and the battles in the desktop build at High, before and after
review.notes: A two-wheeled cart with spoked, iron-tyred wheels on a timber axle, a plank bed with low slatted rails, a folded cover on the bed and a pole with a yoke bar resting on the ground. The pole runs along the model's -z, so it turns a quarter (yaw pi/2) to point west like the code-built cart's shafts. Its bed floor stands 0.62 m up, where the load rides.
